visual_summary: In a crowded ceremonial or official interior packed with helmeted figures, a distraught bearded man kneels and weeps over his daughter being blinded. An older white-haired man tends to the young woman’s glowing eye wounds while speaking calmly. The older man then proposes a political-marital remedy: the daughter should accept Melmoth as husband and cast a vote so he can receive a high-status medallion and noble rank. The father appears overwhelmed with gratitude or grief. In the final tier, the scene is interrupted by a violent crash as a large flying creature or craft bursts through the structure and splatters a helmeted onlooker.
